## Duty and leave: Co-edit team leave schedules online with automatic counts

Enable your team to co-edit online with real-time updates, due-date reminders, and automatic counts of people on leave or on duty.

## Marketing calendar: A full year of marketing highlights, planned for you

Plan key marketing campaigns by month, set To-Do tasks, and co-edit with mentioned Users and partners.

## Holiday travel plan: One document to organize your entire trip

Includes a packing list, itinerary, hotel and attraction notes, and an expense breakdown. You can also insert maps, Mind Maps, and Videos into the document to make travel planning effortless.

**DingTalk Template tips:** Sign in to DingTalk Docs on desktop and open the Template Gallery to claim more scenario-based templates with a single click.

*   In the left-hand navigation of DingTalk, click Document, then click Template in the upper-right corner to open the Template Gallery.

*   Enter keywords in the Search box to quickly find the template you want.
